login.title: From source documents to traceable emission data
login.body: Log in once through Keycloak. The token carries your company (tenant); the gateway and every service verify it again.
login.hint: Demo accounts: alice (Company A – steel) or bob (Company B – logistics).
config.accepts: Your company's configuration accepts {count} document types:
upload.title: Upload a document
upload.drop: Drop or click to choose a PDF, an image or an e-invoice XML (up to 10 MB)
samples.title: Sample documents
samples.empty: No sample documents for this company.
pipeline.title: Processing pipeline
pipeline.idle: Upload a document to see each step.
step.gateway: Gateway verifies the token (JWT) and tenant
step.store: Original file stored in the company's own storage
step.classify: AI classifies the document using the company's configuration
step.extract: AI extracts fields with a confidence score
step.persist: Results saved and linked to the original document
step.publish: Event published on the bus (NATS) for other apps
result.unknown: Not one of the configured document types
documents.title: Company documents
facilities.title: Company facilities
facilities.body: Read through GraphQL (Hasura) behind the gateway; each company only sees its own data.
error.session: Your session has expired, please log in again.
review.saved: Saved. The document is marked as reviewed.
duplicate.found: This document was already uploaded ({file}, by {user} at {time}). No duplicate was created, so emissions are not counted twice.
ledger.title: Emission ledger (Carbon Ledger)
ledger.body: Reviewed documents reach the Carbon Ledger app through the event bus, wait for an approver, then emissions = activity × factor.
ledger.entries: Recorded emissions (click to see where they come from)
ledger.approved: Approved and recorded in the ledger.
ledger.noEntries: No emissions recorded in this period yet.
lineage.title: Where this figure comes from (lineage)
lineage.autoAccepted: AI confident enough, no correction needed
lineage.provisional: Provisional factor: replace with the officially published value before reporting.
seal.openHint: When every activity is approved, close the period to seal its figures in the Trillian log (they can no longer be changed).
seal.detail: {count} entries · leaf #{index} in a Trillian tree of size {size} · root {root}… · closed by {user}
seal.confirm: Close period {period}? Afterwards nothing in this period can be approved or changed.
seal.sealed: Period {period} closed and sealed in the Trillian log.
seal.valid: Seal valid: {count} entries match the sealed data.
seal.invalid: TAMPERING DETECTED: the current data does not match the seal in the Trillian log.
inbox.title: My approvals
inbox.body: Approval steps from your company's BPMN processes, shown only to users with the matching role. Each company can have a different approval flow without code changes.
inbox.empty: Nothing is waiting for your approval.
inbox.nextStep: Moved to the next approval step.
purchase.title: Purchase requests (Purchase Approval)
purchase.body: A second app reusing the same Document Intake, event bus and workflow: purchase invoices are routed here, not to the emission ledger.
dash.title: Emissions dashboard
dash.body: Updates instantly whenever figures are approved or a period is sealed, without reloading the page.
